simple.meaning: חֹסֶר (chôçer) is a Hebrew word meaning “poverty.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֹסֶר (H2640) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:48, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹסֶר (H2640) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֹסֶר (H2640) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֹסֶר (chôçer) / H2640 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:48, Deuteronomy 28:57, Amos 4:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
